model.fitErrorMethod: Reported +/- fitted-parameter error bars from 1000 randomized data sets generated by sampling within the experimental error ranges on the measured growth-inhibition data; do not interpret these fit errors as standard deviations.

provenance.context: Escherichia coli K-12 MG1655, modified Neidhardt potassium-MOPS defined media, 37 C; carbon-source families use 0.2% v/v glycerol or 0.2% w/v glucose with richer variants described by Greulich et al. 2015.
provenance.limitation: The fitted parameters and equation are source-context growth-inhibition authority. They are not a chloramphenicol killing hazard, not a resistant-genotype response, and not authority to relabel Petra's current dimensionless model-resource field as glucose or glycerol.

limitations: Fit selection must be explicit from a compatible environment record; no default carbon source is authorized.
Drug-free growth rates outside the measured carbon-family envelope are out of domain for this v1 authority.
Concentration is micromolar and must not be silently aliased to the ciprofloxacin mg/L field.
No CAT resistance curve, mutation rate, multi-drug interaction, physical transport, or clinical dosing semantics are authorized by this record.
